  # the comment above that assignment, verbatim:
  // Untyped tools (JS extensions) can return results without content; normalize
  // so the null never enters session history or provider payloads.

## 4. bash reports zero output as ONE EMPTY TEXT BLOCK, not as []
$ grep -n 'text: outputText' node_modules/.pnpm/@earendil-works+pi-coding-agent@*/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/tools/bash.js
  280:                const { text: outputText, details } = formatOutput(snapshot);
  303:                return { content: [{ type: "text", text: outputText }], details, structuredContent };
# so for every other tool on this platform 'the command ran and printed nothing' IS
# content: [] — which is the measurement that makes [] unable to carry a verdict.

  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/provider.ts:408:          content: [{ type: "text" as const, text: `Error: ${errMsg}` }],
# a throw during prompt build ends the turn with that error string as the assistant's
# text, while the [] toolResult stays in pi's session history, so the next full-
# history build raises again: the session is unusable on this provider.

## 6. the three empty states, as the delivered module prints them
$ git grep -n -A5 'EMPTY_NOTICES = {' -- packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts
  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts:75:const EMPTY_NOTICES = {
  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts-76-  "zero-bytes": "[the tool delivered an empty payload: zero bytes of output]",
  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts-77-  "no-content-blocks":
  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts-78-    "[the runtime recorded a tool result with no content blocks: no text was delivered, and this site cannot tell a tool that produced none from a payload that never arrived]",
  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts-79-} as const;
  packages/pi-claude-cli/src/tool-result-authority.ts-80-
# zero-bytes        = a text block was delivered and held nothing (the bash shape)
# no-content-blocks = no text block at all (the [] shape); the wording names that
#                     this site cannot tell the two causes apart — the AC8c limit
# unreadable shape  = raises, and no text is returned
